questions.question: An L-shaped path (made of two rectangles): outer = 10×6 m, a 4×3 m rectangle cut from top-right corner. Perimeter of the L-shape =
questions.explanation: Tracing the boundary: 10 + 6 + 4 + 3 + (10−4) + (6−3) = 10 + 6 + 4 + 3 + 6 + 3 = 32 m. (The cut creates two extra edges that replace two shorter ones.)

questions.question: A wire of length 132 cm is bent to form a regular polygon with each side 12 cm. How many sides does the polygon have?
questions.explanation: Number of sides = Total perimeter ÷ side length = 132 ÷ 12 = 11 sides.

questions.question: A rectangle's length is 3 times its breadth. Perimeter = 96 cm. Length =
questions.explanation: Let breadth = b, length = 3b. P = 2(3b + b) = 2(4b) = 8b = 96 → b = 12. Length = 3 × 12 = 36 cm.
